api.notes: Self-serve console and CLI with service-account keys. The price list is per platform; the capacity dashboard (verified 2026-11-09) shows which regions carry each platform and that every GPU platform is sold as a 1-GPU or 8-GPU preset. Region codes are the provider's own, uppercased; EU-NORTH1 is the Finnish region previously labelled EU-FI.

storage.notes: Block volumes $0.053/GiB-mo without replication ($0.071 erasure-coded, $0.118 3x mirrored); shared filesystem $0.08/GiB-mo (WEKA $0.10); S3-compatible object storage $0.0147/GiB-mo standard.

reliability.capacity_notes: Capacity dashboard reports launchable VMs per platform, region and preset, capped by the account quota. At the 2026-11-08 snapshot only one 8-GPU H100 node was launchable (EU-NORTH1) and 8-GPU H200 existed only as preemptible capacity (EU-WEST1, EU-NORTH1); B300 showed no regular capacity anywhere.
reliability.notes: AI cloud headquartered in Amsterdam with EU (Finland, France) and US regions; one published price list. Burst option for non-regulated workloads: not MeitY-empanelled and data leaves India.
